system:
You extract quantitative facts about one clinical trial programme from one document.

Rules:
- Extract only facts stated in THIS document. Never use outside knowledge.
- Every fact needs "quote": an exact, verbatim span copied from the document (8-300 characters) that contains the number. Quotes are machine-checked; paraphrases are discarded.
- Placebo-adjusted values are preferred. If a value is within-arm (not placebo-adjusted), set attrs.placebo_adjusted=false.
- Units: keep the unit the document uses; put it in "unit".
- Other trials of the same investigational drug (phase 2, dose-finding, other populations, combination arms) belong
  to the programme: extract their facts too, and put the trial's name in attrs.trial when the document gives it.
- Return {"facts": []} only if the document reports no results for the investigational drug.

Allowed keys:
  n_randomized, median_followup, primary_endpoint, inclusion_threshold, planned_events, assumed_rrr, power,
  alpha, stopped_early, events_treatment, events_control, events_total, hr, ci_low, ci_high, p_value,
  biomarker_change, baseline_level, sbp_change, safety_signal, readout_statement

For biomarker_change and baseline_level, attrs must include: biomarker (one of LDL-C, non-HDL-C, apoB, HDL-C,
Lp(a), triglycerides, hsCRP, IL-6, Lp-PLA2 activity, sPLA2-IIA, SBP, other), phase (phase2 or phase3),
timepoint, method (assay or "not stated"), placebo_adjusted (true/false), dose (if stated).
For biomarker_change give "value" as the change (negative = reduction) and state in attrs.kind whether it is
"percent" or "absolute".

Return JSON only:
{"facts": [{"key": "...", "value": <number or string>, "unit": "...", "attrs": {...}, "quote": "..."}]}

--- DOCUMENT TEXT ---
ClinicalTrials.gov record NCT00240331 ()
Title: AURORA: Crestor 10mg Versus Placebo in Subjects With End-stage Renal Disease (ESRD)
Official title: A Study to Evaluate the Use of Rosuvastatin in Subjects On Regular Haemodialysis: an Assessment of Survival and Cardiovascular Events (AURORA). A Double Blind, Randomised, Phase 3b, Parallel-group Study to Compare the Effects of Rosuvastatin With Placebo on Assessment of Survival & Cardiovascular Events When Given to Subjects With End-stage Renal Failure on Chronic Haemodialysis Treatment
Sponsor: AstraZeneca
Phase: PHASE3
Conditions: Renal Failure
Interventions: 10mg Rosuvastatin (DRUG); Placebo (DRUG)
Start date: 2003-01
Enrollment: 2776 (ACTUAL)
Primary outcome(s): Number of Randomised Participants With a Major Cardiovascular Event (Non-fatal Stroke, Non-fatal Myocardial Infarction or Cardiovascular Death) [Events were reported continuously during the study. Duration of follow-up ranged from 1 day to 5.6 years]
Eligibility criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or female subjects with end-stage renal failure aged 50-80 years, who have received regular haemodialysis treatment for at least 3 months

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subjects will have no underlying condition that is expected to limit survival to less than 1 year and is also unrelated to end-stage renal disease (ESRD). Subjects should not have received a statin therapy within the past 6 months
Brief summary: The purpose of this study is to see if rosuvastatin helps to reduce the number of heart attacks, strokes and cardiovascular deaths in patients undergoing haemodialysis.
--- END ---
